subject: language
document: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1 to 8: Language (2023)
checkedBy: Opus build session, against the official PDF: The Ontario Curriculum, Grades 1 to 8, Language, 2023 (revised curriculum issued June 2023), downloaded from the Ministry site on 2026-10-11. The word shapes come from the Language Foundations Continuum in the official Kindergarten 2026 PDF, which lists CCVC and CVCC words under Grade 1.
partial: Release one carries B2.4 (four-letter and silent-e words), B2.8 (reading sentences) and B3.3 (capitals and end marks). High-frequency words come next.

expectations.label: Read and spell words by sounding them out
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. This release covers four-letter words like frog and lamp, and silent-e words like cake and bike.

expectations.label: Read short sentences smoothly and accurately
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. Sentences use every word shape she has learned and her sight words; a quick game practises the sight words on their own.

expectations.label: Start a sentence with a capital and end it with the right mark
expectations.note: Paraphrase. The official wording is at sourceUrl. This release covers the first capital, the period and the question mark.

taughtSetExtra.source: Grade 1 adds these to the kindergarten letter-sounds, for silent-e words. The Ministry's Kindergarten to Grade 1 continuum lists VCe patterns under Grade 1.

order.note: a says its name, as in cake
i says its name, as in bike
o says its name, as in rope
u says its name, as in cube
the e at the end that makes no sound

taughtWordsExtra.source: Grade 1 high-frequency words, drafted by the build session and approved by Casim and his wife on 2026-10-12. A school's own list replaces it in parent settings.
